title: xapros SMP
description: Xapros SMP is a Vanilla Fabric SMP with a friendly 18+ community. We always welcome new players!
body:
## We are Xapros SMP, a chill vanilla Minecraft server for adults!




![Our spawn](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/89f32cad29b691e06c6cd421c3587cc56a8df4c3.jpeg)

Why _you_ should join us:

🌍 **Global 18+ Community**
We’ve got players from all over the world! Europe, Australia, the US, Africa, you name it. Thanks to the mix of time zones, there’s  someone online no matter when you log in.

⏰ **Long Term**
We won't reset. We started in January 2025 and we won't be bored for a very very long time. This is the server for your long term megabuild!

👥 **Active Playerbase**
We average around 20–25 people online during peak, it's never empty.

⚙️ **Great Performance, No Lag**
We run on a Ryzen 9950X with 32GB RAM, the best you can get. The server won't lag no matter what you do.

🦇 **Phantom Toggle**
You can toggle off phantoms for yourself or leave them on if you are a masochist. Your choice!

🔓 **No Land Claims, Still Safe**
We keep things vanilla, so there are no land claims but griefing/theft is strictly forbidden. You can always check with */ledger inspect* if anything is missing.

🏙️ **Awesome Spawn & Player Shops**
We’ve got a beautiful spawn area and a diamond-based shopping district where players can trade all kinds of stuff.

🛣️ **Nether Ice Boat Highways**
Fast travel is very simple with our well-connected Nether highway system. Go full speed, we don’t do speed limits!

🗺️ **Bluemap Access**
You can check out the whole world using our [Bluemap](http://map.xaprosmp.xyz/). It’s super handy for planning builds and exploring.

🌍 **No world borders**
You get the space you need. If you want to live on a lonely island hundreds of thousands of blocks from spawn, nobody will stop you!

💸 **Free to Play** 
We’re not trying to make money off this. No ranks, no donation perks. Just a server run as a hobby because we love Minecraft.

🔥 **BlazeandCave Advancements**
Looking for a challenge? We’ve got BlazeandCave’s advancements added in.

🔧 **Fabric, Not Spigot/Paper**
We run on Fabric, so all your redstone contraptions and farms will behave just like they do in singleplayer. No server changes to vanilla!





## ✅ Interested?

Joining is easy! Just hop into our [Discord](https://discord.gg/A48UEbZbad) and go through a quick application. Nothing complicated. If you love vanilla Minecraft and chill communities, you’ll fit right in.

Hope to see you soon 💜
